messages.content: my service canada account log in

message.content:
To **log in to My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**, use the sign-in method you registered with before: **GCKey**, **Interac® Sign-In Partner** (your bank), or a **provincial sign-in** if you live in an eligible province.[4][3]

- If you already have an account, go to the **My Service Canada Account** sign-in page and choose the same sign-in option you used when you registered.[4]
- If you signed up with **GCKey**, enter your GCKey username and password.[4][1]
- If you signed up with **Interac® Sign-In Partner**, use your online banking sign-in credentials.[4]
- If you live in a participating province, you can sign in or register with your **provincial sign-in**; if you live outside those provinces, use **GCKey** or your **bank**.[3]
- If you cannot sign in, the Government of Canada help page says you may need to verify identity information exactly as it appears in Service Canada records, and GCKey users can use recovery options like **forgot username** or **forgot password**.[5][1]

If you want, I can also give you the exact steps for **first-time registration** or help you figure out **which sign-in option you should use**.
